sub_clusters.description: Sequential waves of Micronesian and Samoan settlers; atoll adaptation.

sub_clusters.description: Communal governance in thatched meeting houses; clan seating hierarchy.

sub_clusters.name: Atoll Navigation and Fishing
sub_clusters.description: Star path navigation; deep-ocean fishing traditions; canoe culture.

930.name: European Contact

sub_clusters.description: American whalers frequent the Gilberts; shore stations; cultural disruption.

sub_clusters.name: Missionary Arrival
sub_clusters.description: Protestant (ABCFM) and Catholic missions; Hiram Bingham Jr; literacy.

940.name: British Colonial Period
940.description: Gilbert and Ellice Islands Protectorate; phosphate mining on Banaba.

sub_clusters.name: Gilbert and Ellice Islands Protectorate
sub_clusters.description: British protectorate; later colony status 1916; minimal administration.

sub_clusters.name: Banaba Phosphate Mining
sub_clusters.description: British Phosphate Commissioners strip-mine Ocean Island; displacement of Banabans.

950.name: World War II — Battle of Tarawa
950.description: Japanese occupation; pivotal US Marine assault on Tarawa.

sub_clusters.name: Japanese Occupation
sub_clusters.description: Japan occupies Gilbert Islands; forced labour; Betio fortified.

sub_clusters.name: Battle of Tarawa
sub_clusters.description: Bloody US Marine assault on Betio; 1,000+ US and 4,700 Japanese killed in 76 hours.

sub_clusters.name: Separation of Ellice Islands
sub_clusters.description: Referendum separates Polynesian Ellice Islands from Micronesian Gilberts.

sub_clusters.name: Kiribati Independence (1979)
sub_clusters.description: Independence 12 July 1979; Ieremia Tabai first president.

960.name: Nuclear Testing Legacy
960.description: British nuclear tests on Kiritimati (Christmas Island); health and environmental legacy.

sub_clusters.name: British Nuclear Tests on Kiritimati
sub_clusters.description: Operation Grapple hydrogen bomb tests; servicemen and islanders exposed.

960.name: Climate Crisis — Existential Threat
960.description: Kiribati as ground zero for sea-level rise; 'migration with dignity'.

sub_clusters.name: Sea Level Rise Threat
sub_clusters.description: Average elevation 2m above sea; saltwater intrusion; erosion; relocation planning.

sub_clusters.name: Migration with Dignity Policy
sub_clusters.description: President Tong's policy; land purchased in Fiji; climate refugee debates.

sub_clusters.name: Phoenix Islands Protected Area
sub_clusters.description: World's largest marine protected area; UNESCO World Heritage.
